export_calendar: Add due tasks to a calendar
export_help: Exports hold everything on this device, including shared spaces. JSON keeps every detail and can be imported again; Markdown opens in any notes app. Imported items join your own space, and items already here are skipped. The calendar file holds open tasks with a due day, as all-day events; importing a newer one updates them in most calendar apps.
